translations.value:
We use cookies and SDK tools (Software Development Kit) on our website and in our app. Some of them are necessary, while others help us improve this website and your user experience. To personalize ads, we and our partners process personal data using cookies and advertising IDs. We also use these technologies for non-personalized ads. Do you agree to the use of cookies and SDK tools?
More about cookies

Technical cookies are necessary for the website and all its features to work properly. They keep the products in the cart, show the list of favourite products and make the filters and the login work. Without these cookies the website will not work properly, so they are enabled by default and cannot be disabled. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information. In the mobile app we also use technical SDK tools besides cookies.

We use cookies on our website and in our app. In the mobile app we also use SDK tools besides cookies. SDK tools work similarly to cookies. They collect certain information about your device or about your interaction with our app. Some of the cookies and SDK tools are necessary, while others help us improve the website, the app and your user experience. Do you agree to the use of all cookies and SDK tools? More about cookies

We use personalization cookies to adapt our shop to your needs and interests and to give you a better shopping experience. Thanks to personalization cookies we can tailor the offer directly to you. With personalization cookies you avoid unsuitable product recommendations and other useless offers. In the mobile app we also use personalization SDK tools besides cookies.

Analytics cookies allow us to measure the performance of our website and our advertising campaigns. With them we determine the number of visits and the sources of the visits of our website. We process the data collected by these cookies in aggregate, without identifiers that point to specific users of our website. If you disable analytics cookies in your browser, we lose the ability to analyze the performance of our website and optimize it. In the mobile app we also use analytics SDK tools besides cookies.
Partners: Firebase, Example CDP, Sentry

Advertising cookies are used by us or our partners to show you suitable content or ads both on our website and on third-party websites. This information usually does not allow your immediate identification because only anonymized data is used. If you do not give your consent, you will not be offered content and ads tailored to your interests and needs. In the mobile app we also use advertising SDK tools besides cookies.

Advertising partners and their use of cookies:
Google
Microsoft
Example Ads
